description: Search documents published on schools' own websites (admissions policies, SEND information reports, pupil premium statements, curriculum and behaviour policies, the length of the school week, term dates and menus) by topic. Returns passages with a link to the school's document. Needs a local authority or one school. Can also be limited to one type of document.

answer.description: Also return a generated summary of the top passages in which every sentence cites a passage by its position (1 is the first). Left out when the site has no answer model or the summary fails its checks

doc_type.description: One of admissions_policy, send_report, pupil_premium, curriculum, behaviour, school_week, term_dates, menu

local_authority.description: Only schools in this council (name or code)

query.description: What to look for, such as sibling priority, reading scheme or school day

name: search_school_documents
